sources.title: Qwen3.8 27B (free) API — Pricing & Benchmarks · OrcaRouter
sources.snippet: Qwen3.8-27B is Alibaba's open-weight 27B dense model, released under Apache-2.0 and self-hosted on OrcaRouter's own infrastructure. This deployment is text-in, text-out, with a 64K-token context window (65,536 positions) built on the Qwen3.5 architecture - 64 layers, 5120 hidden size.
